OUR CLASSES

No matter where you are on your fitness path, we build training spaces that empower you to hit hard, lift smart, and grow stronger. Experience group training that feels like personal training.

INTENSITY: HIGH

HIIT

High-intensity interval training designed to push limits, accelerate heart rate, and torch calories fast using functional movements and dynamic structures.

Duration: 45 Mins • All levels welcome
INTENSITY: CHALLENGING

Strength & Conditioning

Master structured barbell mechanics, kettlebell complexes, and compound functional work to build real-world power, lean muscle mass, and mental toughness.

Duration: 60 Mins • Coach-led scaling
INTENSITY: RESTORATIVE

Yoga

Focused mobility drills, deep dynamic recovery, and targeted breath work designed to decrease physical soreness, protect joints, and balance hard physical training.

Duration: 50 Mins • Deep Recovery focus
INTENSITY: HIGH

Spin

High-energy indoor cycling sessions fueled by driving music and expert pacing. Build cardiovascular engine power and target intense metabolic adaptation.

Duration: 45 Mins • Rhythm & Cardio
INTENSITY: LIGHT - MODERATE

Beginner Bootcamp

A highly welcoming, foundation-building class geared specifically for anyone new to fitness. Safely learn foundational lifting forms and metabolic bodyweight routines.

Duration: 45 Mins • No experience required

WEEKLY CLASS TIMES

To serve your busy lifestyle, Lowcountry Strength classes run multiple times daily. Whether you train with the sunrise crew, catch a midday pump, or decompress in the evening, we have you covered.

MORNINGS: 5:30 AM — 9:00 AM MIDDAY: 12:00 PM — 1:00 PM EVENINGS: 4:30 PM — 7:30 PM

*Exact daily schedules, specialty weekend classes, and coach assignments are posted live inside the club and available to members.
